summary: Public buttons/icons now link straight to stored URL (no /going redirect); clicks counted by JS; javascript: links become clickable (stored XSS).

statements.text: ! Links in buttons.blade.php now go straight to an address people saved; a 'javascript:' one runs code in clickers' browsers... only allow http/https.
statements.why: Correct stored XSS risk and fix (UserController stores links unvalidated).

misses.what: Click statistics change: JS only, once per link per session, not when clicking the button's icon image, so counts drop.
Buttons lost base 'button' class (now 'button-click button-hover'), so custom CSS look may change.
Visitors go directly to destination (no /going/ redirect, no noindex header); referrer behavior differs.
